offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures and sells less-lethal personal security devices, mainly CO2-powered launchers that fire kinetic and chemical irritant projectiles, plus ammunition and accessories. Sells to consumers, law enforcement and international customers through online, retail and dealer channels.

primary_products.value: less-lethal launchers; projectile ammunition; CO2 cartridges; holsters and accessories; bear spray

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers seeking home and personal defense; B2B: dealers, distributors and retailers, private security; B2G: law enforcement and security agencies

end_markets.value: personal self-defense; law enforcement; private security; outdoor safety

revenue_model.value: product sales: launchers, ammunition and accessories sold to consumers, dealers and agencies

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and assembles launchers and ammunition from components, sold to consumers, dealers and agencies; brand owner: markets own branded security products directly and through retailers

geography_served.value: global: United States primary, plus Europe, Canada, Latin America and other international markets where legal

specialization.value: related lines: launchers, projectile ammunition, accessories and related personal security items

distribution_channels.value: online: direct-to-consumer website sales; third-party retail: big-box and sporting goods retailers; distributors / dealers: firearms dealers and international distributors; direct sales: law enforcement and government agencies
distribution_channels.category: online; third-party retail; distributors / dealers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: weapons rules, state and local restrictions, export controls, and foreign laws limiting launcher sales and shipping

notes: Product details and channel mix are from general knowledge and may have changed.
